Commit 89b4102

Browse filesBrowse the repository at this point in the historyBrowse files
arsfeld
committed
fix(media): require update and delete permission for library bulk actions
The library page is reachable by guest and readonly users, and its write handlers never checked the role, so any of them could push batch_monitor, batch_unmonitor, toggle_item_monitored, batch_edit_submit, batch_reclassify, trigger_rescan or batch_delete_confirmed over the socket. Gate them on update_media / delete_media like batch_auto_search already is. The handler bodies move into private functions (and two small modules) so index.ex does not grow past the size ratchet.
